# The Vogue News (thevoguenews.com)
> The premier independent GCC luxury daily broadsheet, high jewellery journal, and verified assay intelligence wire.

## Organization & Editorial Profile
- **Publication**: The Vogue News
- **Website**: https://thevoguenews.com/
- **Founding Date**: 2020
- **Editorial Bureaus**: Dubai (DIFC), Abu Dhabi (Al Maryah Island), Riyadh (KAFD), Doha (West Bay), Kuwait City.
- **Coverage**: Certified 925 sterling silver, Dubai Central Laboratory (DCL) assay standards, sovereign bridal suites, Italian micro-prong craftsmanship, and GCC high jewellery commerce.
- **Syndicated Wire Feeds**: Gulf News Focus, Khaleej Times, Vogue Arabia Special, Harper's Bazaar Middle East.
- **Editorial Policies**: https://thevoguenews.com/editorial-policy
- **Corrections Policy**: https://thevoguenews.com/corrections
- **Contact & Press Wire**: https://thevoguenews.com/contact

## Verified Technical & Gemological Benchmarks
- **Elemental Metal Purity**: All spotlighted demi-fine bridal suites are constructed from solid 925 sterling silver verified via X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) spectrometry under UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 23 (DCL Hallmarking Compliance).
- **Simulated Diamonds & Gemstones**: High-density simulated diamonds featuring 2.65 optical dispersion index and 58 hand-faceted facets, hand-set with Italian micro-prong claws (never glued).
- **Anti-Tarnish Barrier**: Electrolytic triple-rhodium and 18K Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) gold vacuum bonding resisting salt-fog coastal humidity across the Arabian Gulf.
